name: smwblocks-keyhole-block-v1
title: Keyhole Block v1.3
description:
This is a block which acts just like the keyhole sprite (Sprite Command E). It ends the level if Mario is holding a key or if Yoshi has a key in his mouth.

Version 1.3 adds a couple of defines and centers the keyhole level end effect on the screen in order to prevent crashing at certain block positions.
